function.name: find_my_appointment
function.description: Look up the caller's upcoming visits booked from the number they're calling from (never another number). Use when a caller wants to move, cancel or check an existing visit. found: appointments (newest first) with spoken window, service_address, service_unit and appointment_id; read the first back ("I see your visit on [spoken] at [short address]. Is that the one?") and act only on a yes. none_found or no_caller_id: offer a callback (request_followup with reason booking_change). Does not change anything.

bot_say.description: Spoken to the caller while this runs: one brief, natural acknowledgment (2-6 words) that fits this moment, e.g. "Let me pull that up". Vary it from your last one. In the caller's current language. No trailing punctuation.
